title: DAVE THE DIVER: Vault Extras
notes: Bonus goals for DAVE THE DIVER on top of its Steam achievements: the full sea-life collection, every boss trophy, big catches, the sushi bar, and the In the Jungle DLC (which has no Steam achievements).
Read from your save files (AppData\LocalLow\nexon\DAVE THE DIVER). Progress counts from everything Vault has seen in your saves, so playing on and saving keeps adding to it.

testGuide.title: Turn on Vault Extras
testGuide.detail: On the DAVE THE DIVER page, press Turn on under Vault Extras.

testGuide.title: Save once
testGuide.detail: Play and let the game save (or save from the menu). Achievements for what you already have pop straight away.
